name: Micah
bio: Micah of Moresheth prophesied against Samaria and Jerusalem during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah, condemning corrupt rulers, priests, and prophets who exploited the poor while claiming God's favor. He famously declared that the LORD required not empty sacrifices but justice, mercy, and humble obedience, recalling how God had redeemed Israel from Egypt through Moses, Aaron, and Miriam and vindicated them even when Balak hired Balaam to curse them. Micah also prophesied that a ruler would come from the small town of Bethlehem to shepherd Israel, and closed with confident hope that God would again show mercy and faithfulness to Jacob and Abraham's descendants despite their sin (Micah 1:1-7:20). His warning that Jerusalem would become a heap of rubble was remembered decades later by the elders who defended Jeremiah from execution.
